[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-14d[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Client-side notification delivery rules[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]A person receiving SASE notifications can match them by tab, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]sender, action, tag, title, or note text, and decide per match [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]whether a TUI toast is shown and whether the announcement is the [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]terminal bell, a custom sound file, or silence. Task-bead [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]notifications announce nothing on every machine, and kellys_mbp [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]announces with a sound file instead of the bell.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]6[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]5[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Rule matcher in the Rust core[/bold #D7AFFF]                                 [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]core-rules[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]core-rules: add notification delivery rule wire types, the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]first-match-per-field resolver, a case-insensitive glob matcher, and the[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]batched resolve_notification_deliveries PyO3 binding to sase-core, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]reusing tab_key_for for the tab criterion.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Config surface and Python facade[/bold #D7AFFF]                              [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]config-rules[dim] · [dim][/dim]after core-rules[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]config-rules: ratchet the pinned core revision, add [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]ace.notification_rules to default_config.yml and the JSON schema, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]add the token-cached Python facade that reads the rules and resolves [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]deliveries through the new binding.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Sound file playback[/bold #D7AFFF]                                           [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]sound-backend[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]sound-backend: add a presentation-side sound module that resolves a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]platform audio player (afplay on macOS; paplay, aplay, then ffplay on [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Linux) and plays a file without ever raising into the event loop.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Apply rules in the notification poll[/bold #D7AFFF]                          [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]tui-delivery[dim] · [dim][/dim]after core-rules, config-rules, sound-backend[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]tui-delivery: resolve each arriving notification's delivery on the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]existing worker hop, filter toast-suppressed rows out before batching, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and play at most one resolved sound per poll tick in place of the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]unconditional tmux bell.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]sase notify rules, doctor check, and docs[/bold #D7AFFF]                     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]observability[dim] · [dim][/dim]after config-rules, sound-backend, tui-delivery[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]observability: add the sase notify rules subcommand with [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]per-notification explanation, a config.notification_rules doctor check, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and the notifications docs section describing matching, resolution, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]playback.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]The two requested configurations[/bold #D7AFFF]                              [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
